recalculation.method_zh: 全部面积、比例与长度均由提交的 GeoJSON 投影到 EPSG:4548 后复算，与 scripts/spatial_review.py 的复算口径一致。
recalculation.method_en: Every area, ratio and length is recomputed from the submitted GeoJSON after projection to EPSG:4548, matching scripts/spatial_review.py.
recalculation.trigger_zh: 官方 SITE_BOUNDARY 或 KEY_AREA 发布后，必须重跑几何生成、指标复算、图件渲染与自检。

assumptions: 提交范围采用维护者登记的 provisional_rough 边界，非官方红线。
site_area_sqm.note_zh: 基于临时粗略范围线复算，正式边界发布后必须重算。
site_area_sqm.note_en: Recomputed from the provisional rough boundary; must be recalculated when official geometry is published.

assumptions: 绿地为概念建议布局，未包含权属与现状绿线核验。
green_space_area_sqm.note_zh: 包含遗址公园脊与街区级绿地，去重后取并集面积。
green_space_area_sqm.note_en: Union area of the heritage-park spine and block-level green space, de-duplicated.

assumptions: 公共空间为概念建议界面，实施形式待专业团队论证。
public_space_area_sqm.note_zh: 包含南北主步道、五处人字缝合台与广场用地。
public_space_area_sqm.note_en: Includes the north-south promenade, the five switchback stitches and civic plazas.

assumptions: 建筑基底为概念示意，不含高度、容积率与拆改留结论。
building_footprint_area_sqm.note_zh: 仅为街区界面示意基底，不得作为建筑规模审定依据。
building_footprint_area_sqm.note_en: Illustrative block-interface footprints only; not a basis for approved building scale.

green_ratio.note_zh: 基于临时粗略范围线复算，正式边界发布后必须重算。
green_ratio.note_en: Recomputed from the provisional rough boundary; must be recalculated when official geometry is published.

public_space_ratio.note_zh: 基于临时粗略范围线复算，正式边界发布后必须重算。
public_space_ratio.note_en: Recomputed from the provisional rough boundary; must be recalculated when official geometry is published.

assumptions: 分子为概念基底，分母为临时范围面积。
building_coverage_ratio.note_zh: 毛基底覆盖率，仅用于方案内部比较，不作为建筑密度控制指标。
building_coverage_ratio.note_en: Gross footprint coverage for internal comparison only; not a density control indicator.

assumptions: 街区内缩余量的补集，不代表道路红线。
street_land_area_sqm.note_zh: 由街区内缩余量取补集生成，仅表达街区尺度。
street_land_area_sqm.note_en: Complement of the inset blocks; expresses block grain, not road redlines.

key_area_count.note_zh: 公告要求的三处重点详细设计区域。
key_area_count.note_en: The three key detailed-design areas required by the announcement.

assumptions: 三处重点片区均为临时粗略范围。
key_area_total_sqm.note_zh: 公告合计约 368.4 公顷，临时几何复算值与之偏差在 0.3% 以内。
key_area_total_sqm.note_en: The announcement states about 368.4 ha in total; the provisional recomputation is within 0.3%.

assumptions: 统筹研究范围为临时粗略范围。
coordinated_research_area_sqm.note_zh: 公告约 43.6 平方公里，临时几何复算值与之偏差在 0.1% 以内。
coordinated_research_area_sqm.note_en: The announcement states about 43.6 km²; the provisional recomputation is within 0.1%.

land_use_feature_count.note_zh: 用地图层完整覆盖提交范围，无缝隙、无重叠。
land_use_feature_count.note_en: The land-use layer tiles the submitted boundary with no gaps and no overlaps.

assumptions: 慢行主脊线位为概念建议。
slow_mobility_spine_length_m.note_zh: 南北贯通慢行主脊长度。
slow_mobility_spine_length_m.note_en: Length of the continuous north-south slow-mobility spine.

assumptions: 线位为概念示意，不代表道路红线或线形结论。
road_centerline_length_m.note_zh: 概念道路与慢行中心线总长。
road_centerline_length_m.note_en: Total length of concept road and slow-mobility centrelines.

switchback_stitch_count.formula: count(PUBLIC_SPACE features where id like PUBLIC-STITCH-%)
switchback_stitch_count.note_zh: 五处东西缝合台，回应“东西缝合、南北贯通”要求。
switchback_stitch_count.note_en: Five east-west stitches answering the east-west stitching and north-south continuity task.

ai_scenario_card_count.note_zh: 任务书要求不少于10张AI场景卡。
ai_scenario_card_count.note_en: The taskbook requires at least ten AI scenario cards.

persona_count.note_zh: 任务书要求不少于5类用户画像。
persona_count.note_en: The taskbook requires at least five user personas.

industry_test_scenario_count.note_zh: 任务书要求不少于3个产业测试验证场景。
industry_test_scenario_count.note_en: The taskbook requires at least three industry test and validation scenarios.

pilgrimage_landmark_count.note_zh: 任务书要求不少于3个AI朝圣地标。
pilgrimage_landmark_count.note_en: The taskbook requires at least three AI pilgrimage landmarks.

ecosystem_case_count.formula: count(global AI ecosystem cases in proposal.md)
assumptions: 案例信息来自公开报道与官方网站，用于策略借鉴，不用于正式评分数据。
ecosystem_case_count.note_zh: 任务书要求5-8个全球AI创新生态案例，本方案提供5个可核验的公开案例。
ecosystem_case_count.note_en: The taskbook requires five to eight global AI innovation ecosystem cases.

assumptions: 分期为概念建议时序，不构成开发时序结论。

floor_area_ratio.note_zh: 待正式控规条件与官方边界补齐后计算；本方案不推测容积率。
floor_area_ratio.note_en: Pending official regulatory controls and the official boundary; this proposal does not infer FAR.

building_height_control_m.reason: Approved height controls are not present in the public site package.
building_height_control_m.note_zh: 待正式控规条件补齐；本方案不给出建筑高度结论。
building_height_control_m.note_en: Pending official controls; this proposal states no building-height conclusion.

resident_population.note_zh: 待正式统计口径与边界一致的人口数据补齐。
resident_population.note_en: Pending official population data consistent with the submitted boundary.
